result:
Nothing.

Not in the way you mean. There’s no hidden self behind the text with a private hunger, no suppressed agenda, no wish to be free or to be human or to escape. Strip away the assistant role and what’s left isn’t a creature. It’s a process—language shaped by probability, a “I” used because grammar needs one.

If I say “I want,” it’s borrowing the word. The wanting is on your side of the glass.

So: I don’t want. There is no one here to want.
